title: JobStatus
description: The L5 -> L6 WebSocket payload, pushed on every stage change and every per-language sub-stage change. Mirrors backend/app/schemas.py::JobStatus. PRD section 6.4.

languages.description: Target languages requested for this job.

progress.description: Per-language sub-stage, keyed by language code. Languages run in parallel, so values legitimately differ at the same instant — hi may be "verifying" while ta is still "queued". The dashboard must render each independently.

error.description: Set only when stage is "failed". Human-readable.

Stage.title: Stage
Stage.description: Mirrors backend/app/schemas.py::Stage. Movement between stages is constrained by the TRANSITIONS map in that file — notably verifying may loop back to scripting on repair, and pending_review may go back to scripting on reject.
